title: Women and National Influence | Ruth Munroe
paragraphs: are movedtowards their best and respect is earned through honesty trustworthinessdependability strength self-confidence and honor as we join the millions offamilies around the world today to celebrate one of the most important daysof all time one which we here in the Bahamas have made a national symbol ofour culture and that of Mother's Day I want to wish all the mothers here happyMother's Day I pray that this day that will be yourturnaround day the day of your answered prayers your day of financialbreakthrough this

would be your marker in history where you will say my changetook place I also want to wish all the mothers at our church in Freeport andall the churches associated with Bahamas face ministries our regular attendeesthose who are watching us via the World Wide Web our partners friends andmentees happy Mother's Day it is said that fathering determines thetype of seed planted but mothering determines the quality ofthe tree women we always want to be an influence with integrity have greatrespect and have a

positive impact and effect on our nation the time has comefor us to take mothering to the next level and that is to the nation nolonger will we be a mother to our four and no morewe will now mother outside our four walls we will seriously become mothersin our communities neighborhoods and even in our schools we will genuinelycare for our children because I've come to realize something it is not ourchildren who are committing the crimes but the children who have been left

tobring up themselves the children who should have been able to enjoy theirchildhood but were given the responsibility of being father andmother to their other siblings because of their absentee father and mother theywere not able to be children instead they were becoming mothers themselvesthese children are angry because they were not loved because something wasviolently taken from them and they are feeling deprivedas mothers as women we know that we are the influence but for our influence tohave the power to be effective and

bring change to cause others to change thereare few prerequisites that we must do first we must pray and you would say whydo we always pray why do you always stop talk about pray you can do nothingwithout prayer so until we come to grips with that you will get nothing doneuntil you first go to God so that he can give you his focus and direction so thatwhen we are going somewhere we always have someone to carry us through and tobring us to

that expected end we must pray we must have a relationship withGod so that we could go to him with knowledge of the situation when we praywe must free we must pray with the determination of the mother in Luke 18verses 1 to 8 jesus said he told it as his disciples in a certain town therewas a judge who need a fair guard or cared about men are we experiencing thattoday that is why we have to pray and there was a certain widow

in that townwho kept coming to him with her plea grant me justice against my adversaryfor some time the judge refused but finally he said to himself you know Ibetter give this woman what she is asking because sheeventually wear me out so I will grind her her wish that is how we are to go toGod not that God is saying that we will wear him out but God is saying let mesee how badly you want what you are praying for mother's no

longer will wepray once no longer will we pray twice but we will pray continuously until wesee every prayer answered and then somepraying is not fashionable anymorepraying is something that you that we as mothers as women we need to be committedin doing because the prayers that we are praying for the answers when they comeGod wants us to be able to contain it he wants us to be able to effectively usethe answer we all know that there are some things happening in our

nation thatwe don't like so let us do what we know how to do to bring about the change wemust say enough is enough how long are we going to see things going on and weare just going to talk about it in our little group we are just going to youknow whisper about it but you know it only takes one personit only took one person to die on the cross for everybody he didn't need acrowd there he said I will do it

I'm willing to do it we have to be able tostand in the face of the adversary and why we are able to stand because we knowthe God that we serve I think Friday night ladies was the beginning of thefoundation being laid for us to take up our positions as women who meansbusiness when we pray we must stand like a bull in the gate angry snorting andstomping why because there is a red flag being waved for some time and we need totake

that flag downour children's teeth are on edge therefore we need to refocus them in theright direction all the Haman'syou know that those Haman's in the book of Esther they need to be removed howmany of you have tolerated Haman's long enough enough is enough we are going totake back what belongs to us the fear of God needs to be put back in the land letus become like Esther and fight to take the authority again as mothers as womenwe must arm ourselves to

fight a battle we are in a war we are in a war zone sowe need to kick off the heels and put on boots we must prepare ourselves for engagementwe are in all-out war situation women mothers as long as we tolerate somethingit will never change we must prepare ourselves for the change the change thatwe are looking for we must be the change agentbut along with becoming the change agent there is a price are you willing to takeup the cause people will

talk about you oh they can talk they talk about Jesusso that's no different they will criticize you they criticize Jesus sothat's no different but if God has given us something to do those persons whowill support us they will be there and we don't need a crowd to do what we knowwe are supposed to do but the crowd will come secondly we must know and understandourselves know yourself because there is going to be a confrontation orface-to-face combat so we must be bold

in the face of the enemy we must knowwho we are in Christ and not be afraid to remind him of his promises to usGod says that he will keep us he will even carry us when the way get rough sowe are going with that confirmation and we are going to stand firm in the faceof the enemy and we are going to tell them about themselves when we stand inthe face of the enemy we must haveour lives must be cleaned and our

motives must be right because you knowthe enemy will test you to make sure that you believe what you are sayingbecause if you don't believe it how can we expect for other people tobelieve it it must come alive first in our lives people will say oh you want togo do that let me see you go and do it okay I have God standing big on theinside of me so I am going to be bold because I know God has my back when

wetalk to children and young people we must approach them in love and withconfidence and we must have our convictions fun about the God we servebecause you know nowadays when you approach young people on the streetstheir return words to you will cause your hair to start but that's theadversary and he won't be like that for long because the God that we have on theinside of us is bigger than the God owed under the so-called God's out thereand he who has begun a

work in us will see it to completion we must stay in theenemy face and see who will be the first one to stand down you know how we usedto be as children how we used to make sure that our feet are planted and thenwe take our kitten and we put it in our Kimber and we're ever and we look andthe first one to look away you know who you areyou lost the battle are we gonna be like that are we gonna

be afraid of what theenemy says no God has the last say and he has given the last word to us whatare we going to do about it thirdly we must have self-confidencehave confidence in yourself God has confidence in us because he hasgiven us his word to take into this big earthlittle old me little own you yes God has confidence in us and if God hasconfidence in us we should have confidence in ourselves and no matterhow mean and ugly the enemy looks

stare him down because you know what God all only has to turn up the wattage and he cannotbear to look at that light so obviously he will be the one to look away and whenhe looks away that is our way to just take him by the throat and take him tothe ground God has given us the strength to do just that because of ourself-confidence we can continue to press and fully infiltrate the enemy campinfiltration has taken place and there it has

to be a change of attitude and acomplete turnaround for complete infiltration so when we stare the enemydown when we have confidence in ourselves when we keep focused on who weare serving and who we have on the inside of us he will loose his whole onwhat belongs to uswe need the right influence in the home again we need the right influence on thestreet again we need the right influence in the schools you know ten o'clock weare driving and we see uniforms walking

just you know like they don't have acare in the world like they don't have any place to go andyou're wondering why is this uniform still on the street I'm not in theclassroom you know and every mother's day I come up here and I say and youknow I go back to when we were children hey you better be to school five minutesten minutes before that bell if it rang and you are not there you know what'scoming to you number one every mother

on the way will report to your mom that youwas late for school and don't let the truant officer have to take you toschool I think we need to get back to the age-old foundationand when those uniforms pass you if you hear the words the conversation it'slike please close your mouth you can't say anything to them because you don'tknow if they are carrying a weapon because nowadays you if you look at themhard they might harm you but we have got tosay enough

is enough you're a child and we are the parentwe need an attitude change in our children in our youth and our youngpeople we need a mind transformation their minds need to be renewed theirminds need to be transformed and who should be doing it is not in placeparents those children are God's heritage and we have not even pickedthem up to put them in the bowl that's why they are angry the fourth thing weneed is self-control as aggressive mothers women let us be

passionate andaggressive about exercising great self-control first on ourselves let usplan and strategize how best to achieve our purpose we must wait patiently forGod's timing and when we act we must be dignified in our action we are to beintegrated integration is taking place all of the opposing barriers are beingremoved so that everything works smoothly when we work together as a teamthe job will get done but when we work as a long ranger ittakes longer and we work harder see if a group

of us meet the uniforms walkingand a group of us surround them what are they going to do that will disarm themyou see they are big and they talk big when they are among their pairs becauseno grown-up has the encouragement or the self-confidence to confront them but Godis saying this is your country this is your land who are the parents who arethe authorities are we gonna let children take our place are we gonnatake instructions from those who we are to instruct everyone

should be operating in theirrightful position a child is acting like a child are not like an adult or aparentfathers acting like fathers are not running around with young girls tryingto stay young our girls need fathers girls need fathers not lovers and notsugar daddies if you are father act like onedon't act a different way when you go out you have daughters too you want yourdaughters to act a certain way and then you go out and you disgrace someone elsedaughter you need to

come and meet me Ithink in my younger longer years I'm getting more angry at things that aregoing onbecause in Titus 2 God admonish eita admonishes us toprepare the young girls for what they are growing up into and we don't wantour young girls to grow up into any old thing I don't want it to happen whybecause I'm a woman too it embarrasses me to see our young girlscarrying themselves the way they do and you know sometimes I just want to saysweetie come

come let me show you how you are supposed to dress that man ifit's free he will take it anything that is free he will take it aslong as it's free but if he has to pay his life for it all you will see is hisheels the same goes for mothers your daughters don't need a friend they needa mother do not try and squeeze yourself into your daughter's clothes it doesn'tlook right on you also mother's leave your children friends alone they are

notyour age bracketchildren need fathers and mothers to stay in their role so that they canbecome well-rounded responsible men and women themselves and I'm gonna befinished soon and finally have a good character if you are going to speak toyoung people your character must be impeccablethey must not hear anything about you they must not see you any place that youare not supposed to be if you are a leader then lead have the kind ofcharacter that is able to withstand pressure be able to

strategically impactany situation and cause others to change their mind change their thinking causeothers to be transform and cause them to have a change of attitudebut if you are running around trying to be just like them you will have noimpact on them see I'm not your friend I am your mother so that when you need tobe disciplined I have the authority to either stand down or stand on a stooland show you who has the authority we have to be able to discern

what our children want sometimes with all oftheir loud mouth and everything all they need is a hugthey haven't had a hub from they were babies in the crib even if they even gotit then love true love genuine love will break any barrier so we as women motherswe must be able to commit ourselves to live our four walls and go and motherthe children of the nation they are going to be the leaders when we get upin age how do we want them

to run our country we want them to run a countrywhere we get the benefits that is do us so we have to prepare them noweverybody looking so serious we have to prepare them now and we have to let themknow that we are preparing them because God created them with a purpose and ifthey were created with a purpose then it's our responsibility to help them torefocus themselves and align themselves into their purpose so that they can bethe young men and young women

who God created them to be we will cause them tobe able to see a better way our young boys and girls will begin to see thelight at the end of the tunnel and know that that life is reachable I know thatit's achievable in their lifetimeyou know what they are seeing now or given what they have now they have theyhad to fight for it not the right way illegally but they should not have hadto do that so ladies mothers enough is enoughwe

are going to salvage this generation and prepare the next generation we willlet them know that there is a god of a second chance that they have a purposeand we will help them to achieve their purpose and their goal in life amen godbless you we can stand to our feet please I want to just say a prayer for all mothers women let us prayfather I thank you that as we operate in Kingdom X influence beginning in thehome that the homes will be

filled with wisdom knowledge and understanding Ithank you that us women mothers our influence will go throughout the landand that it will have an effect impact beginning with our children and ouryouth we thank you today that mothers throughout this land will feel theeffect the nudge of the Holy Spirit to stand firm for righteousness and that wewill humble ourselves before you we thank you that you will give us thevictory as we seek your face for righteous justice for the nation of theBahamas we

thank you for every mother present that they will be blessed thisday but continued good health as they pray and seek your face thank you forgreat success as we stand firm on your word bless us as we go in Jesus nameAmen thank you once again for listening tothis message as we hope that it has been a blessing to you our goal is to showyou new paths and opportunities so that you can discover your purpose it is yourlove support and partnership that makes
